notes.notes:
- fixed german loca problems
- optimized item grab targeting

notes.title: b1.0.1 Update
notes.notes:
- fixed german loca problems

notes.title: b1.0.0 Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36306876/ba77a6ea26bdce680627b5bba994c9d2e7c76f6d.png

- 6 new stages added to story mode
- multiplayer map added
- shop content reworked
- character skills and costs reworked
- mode selection reworked for single and multiplayer
- english and german loca updated
- flasks in brewing stands are now removable
- elite enemies added
- enemy spawning rate optimized
- tutorial system reworked
- how to play section has now tabs
- ending screen added
- several bugfixes, yee

- items can now only be placed on tables
